# T002 — Retarget Pricing to .NET 10

## Summary

Retargeted the sole project from `net8.0` to `net10.0`. The Release build and all ten tests pass.

## Changes

- `Pricing.csproj`: changed only `TargetFramework` to `net10.0`. Pricing code, ten tests, and the three package references remain unchanged.
- This progress note records validation and the remaining environment risk.

## Decisions

- The approved plan and assessment select .NET 10 LTS; change the target only initially and preserve packages unless compatibility gates require remediation. Both gates passed, so no dependency changes were necessary. T001 characterized empty-receipt behavior before retargeting and recorded 10/10 passing on .NET 8.
- No lint configuration exists, as documented in `assessment.md`.
